_doc: T188v2 50+50 mega-ensemble + full-horizon emit. h=60 main thresholds derived from DE asymmetric search on LOSO-equiv validation set. h=5/10/20/40 share h=60 ensemble via share_with=60, with thresholds scaled by sqrt(H/60) for shorter-horizon volatility normalization. Platform score = max(per-horizon PnL), so emitting on all five horizons is monotonically safe. Decision rule: action=2 if pred > thr_up; action=0 if pred < -thr_dn; action=1 otherwise (EV gate, sym-agnostic).

horizons._note: share h=60 ensemble; thresholds = h=60 * sqrt(5/60) = * 0.2887
